_note: Slide 24. Read-only tools only: there is no revoke tool and no write tool anywhere in this list, which is the point of slide 31 ('Letting the triage agent act: 0'). llm.parameters.response_filter is required for a conversational agent and is model-specific - $.content[0].text is the Bedrock Anthropic Messages shape.
name: sec-triage
description: Triages an agent-egress finding the way a human would: pace, blast radius, API delta, owner. Recommends. Never revokes.

tools.name: ppl_tool
tools.description: Translate a question about agent traces or security logs into PPL and run it. Use for pacing, blast radius and API-delta questions.

tools.name: anomaly_results_tool
tools.description: Fetch anomaly-detection results, including per-entity grades, for the agent-egress-pace detector.

tools.name: asset_owner_tool
tools.description: Look up the owning team and criticality for a cloud instance or agent id in the asset-owner index.
